text: In a ShortsOS pilot, the ShortsOS team operates the workflow; the one real run completed so far went from source video and render, through human review, to a live Instagram Reel with a captured publication permalink. The review step before publication is a mandatory human checkpoint. Customers do not link their own Instagram account or publish directly through this workflow.
